---
description: Implement a feature end-to-end using the repository's existing architecture and tooling.
---
Implement the requested feature. Discover the relevant architecture first, find existing related code and contracts, identify affected consumers/data, create a focused plan, make the smallest complete change, and for protected features deliver server authorization/organization scope plus shared contract and consumer updates. Add or update tests, run relevant validation, and summarize changed files plus any migration/deployment considerations.
